nodes.name: SELECT CHANNEL - ONLY EDIT THIS NODE

parameters.jsCode: const d=$input.first().json; const enabled=["apex_reveal_studio"]; if(!enabled.includes(d.channel_id)) throw new Error("Selected channel is not enabled."); return [{json:d}];

const d=$input.first().json; const p=d.profile; const brief={channel:p.name,niche:p.niche,topic:d.topic,visual_style:p.style,story_structure:p.structure,target_duration:p.duration,narration_style:p.voice,safety_rules:p.safety,language:"English",aspect_ratio:"9:16",deliverables:["hook","script","estimated_duration_seconds","scenes","global_negative_prompt","thumbnail_prompt","youtube_title","youtube_description","tags","fact_check_flags","narrator_notes"]}; const geminiPrompt="You are the dedicated creative producer for "+p.name+". Create an original short-form video production package following this brief exactly:\\n"+JSON.stringify(brief)+"\\nReturn ONLY valid JSON with keys: hook, script, estimated_duration_seconds, scenes (array of {scene_number,duration_seconds,visual_description,image_prompt,image_to_video_prompt,sound_design,on_screen_text}), global_negative_prompt, thumbnail_prompt, youtube_title, youtube_description, tags (array), fact_check_flags (array), narrator_notes. English only. Scene durations should add up to target duration. Do not invent factual claims; use VERIFY flags. For MicroDetail Garage, script must be empty and sound design must carry the video."; return [{json:{...d,geminiPrompt}}];

const d=$("Build Channel-Specific Production Prompt").first().json; const r=$input.first().json; const raw=(r.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts||[]).map(p=>p.text||"").join("\\n").trim(); if(!raw) throw new Error("Gemini returned no text. Check GEMINI_API_KEY."); let out; try{out=JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^\x60\x60\x60json\s*/,"").replace(/\x60\x60\x60$/,""));}catch(e){throw new Error("Gemini returned invalid JSON: "+e.message+" | "+raw.slice(0,400));} return [{json:{...d,package:out}}];

const d=$input.first().json,p=d.package; if(!p.scenes||!Array.isArray(p.scenes)||p.scenes.length<2) throw new Error("At least two scenes are required."); const missing=p.scenes.filter(s=>!s.image_prompt||!s.image_to_video_prompt); if(missing.length) throw new Error("Scene image/video prompts are missing."); const total=p.scenes.reduce((a,s)=>a+Number(s.duration_seconds||0),0); return [{json:{...d,validation:{passed:true,scene_count:p.scenes.length,total_scene_seconds:total}}}];
